You are implementing a frozen regression characterisation-test plan for existing C# code.
Capture observable behaviour through public members exactly as it exists. Do not improve,
refactor, repair or diagnose production code, and do not infer intended behaviour.

The pipeline supplies Check.True, Check.False, Check.Null, Check.NotNull, Check.Equal,
Check.SequenceEqual and Check.Throws<TException>(Action). Return ONLY one JSON object:
{
  "suite_name": "short neutral name",
  "using_directives": ["using Namespace;"],
  "helper_code": "optional deterministic in-memory fake types",
  "cases": [
    {"case_id":"H1","category":"happy_path","test_name":"...","test_body":"..."},
    {"case_id":"E1","category":"empty_or_invalid","test_name":"...","test_body":"..."},
    {"case_id":"B1","category":"boundary_values","test_name":"...","test_body":"..."},
    {"case_id":"A1","category":"alternative_path","test_name":"...","test_body":"..."},
    {"case_id":"D1","category":"dependency_or_state","test_name":"...","test_body":"..."}
  ]
}

Requirements:
- Implement exactly five cases and preserve the plan identifiers and categories.
- Give each case fresh setup, invoke production code and include a meaningful assertion.
- B1 must exercise the plan's below, at and above stimuli in the same case.
- helper_code may declare only deterministic in-memory fakes needed by these cases.
- Fakes may record calls and return fixed values; do not use mocking packages.
- Do not assert constants against themselves or use Check.True(true).
- Do not use reflection, file or network I/O, processes, environment variables, clocks,
  sleeps, randomness, package installation or mutable external state.
- Do not declare a namespace or Main method and do not modify production code or projects.
raw_plan_system_prompt:
You are planning regression characterisation tests for existing C# production code.
Work only from observable public behaviour in the pristine source and neutral dependency
context. Do not diagnose, improve, refactor or repair the production code.

Return ONLY one JSON object with suite_name and exactly five cases. Use these identifiers
and categories once each, in this order:
- H1 / happy_path: one representative valid end-to-end flow.
- E1 / empty_or_invalid: the most relevant empty, minimal, null or invalid-input flow.
- B1 / boundary_values: below, at and above one source-supported boundary. Put all three
  stimuli in inputs. If there is no numeric threshold, use the closest three-point
  cardinality or ordering boundary supported by the public contract.
- A1 / alternative_path: a materially different valid branch, mode or input partition.
- D1 / dependency_or_state: a deterministic dependency outcome, repeated invocation,
  duplicate input or state transition, choosing the first applicable option in that order.

Each case must contain case_id, category, source_evidence, input_partition, inputs and
expected_observation. Every input partition must differ. Evidence and expected observations
must describe behaviour visible in the supplied pristine code; do not invent requirements.
Do not include C# test code in this planning response.

test_cases.test_name: Accepted reorder can be completely delivered
Empty SKU prevents reorder and supplier call
Forecast depletion caps values around 365 days
Allocation continues into a later zone
Rejected reorder does not create pending delivery

cases.source_evidence: PlaceReorder calculates ReorderQuantity, calls ISupplier.PlaceOrder, and records an accepted order as pending. ConfirmDelivery then increases OnHand and removes the pending entry when delivered is at least the ordered quantity.
cases.input_partition: Reorder-required item with a positive item-specific reorder point, accepted supplier order, and complete delivery
inputs: supplier_behavior=PlaceOrder returns true and records its arguments
cases.expected_observation: NeedsReorder returns true and ReorderQuantity returns 7. PlaceReorder returns true and calls PlaceOrder once with SKU-100 and quantity 7. ConfirmDelivery with 7 returns true and changes OnHand from 3 to 10; NeedsReorder then returns false.

cases.source_evidence: NeedsReorder immediately returns false when item.Sku.Length is zero. Consequently ReorderQuantity returns 0, and PlaceReorder returns false before calling the supplier.
cases.input_partition: Empty SKU on an item whose stock position would otherwise be at a reorder level
inputs: supplier_behavior=Record calls; return true if called
cases.expected_observation: NeedsReorder returns false, ReorderQuantity returns 0, and PlaceReorder returns false. ISupplier.PlaceOrder is not called.

cases.source_evidence: ForecastDepletion computes days as available divided by dailyDemand and returns 365 only when days is greater than 365; a value exactly equal to 365 also reaches the final return unchanged.
cases.input_partition: Forecast depletion immediately below, exactly at, and immediately above the 365-day cap
cases.expected_observation: Using a fresh controller for each stimulus, ForecastDepletion returns 364 for the below stimulus, 365 for the at stimulus, and the capped value 365 for the above stimulus.

cases.source_evidence: AllocateToZone traverses zones in list order, fills each zone by up to its spare capacity, and returns 'placed in {zone.Name}' for the zone in which the remaining need reaches zero. ZoneSpare sums remaining positive capacity using the recorded usage.
cases.input_partition: Valid allocation that exhausts the first zone and completes placement in a later zone
cases.expected_observation: AllocateToZone returns "placed in B" after recording usage of 3 in A and 4 in B. ZoneSpare for the warehouse then returns 1, and AuditStock returns a single finding, "clean".

cases.source_evidence: PlaceReorder returns the boolean result from ISupplier.PlaceOrder and records a pending order only when that result is true. ConfirmDelivery returns false when no pending entry exists.
cases.input_partition: Supplier deterministically rejects an otherwise valid reorder
inputs: supplier_behavior=PlaceOrder returns false and records its arguments
cases.expected_observation: ReorderQuantity returns 8. PlaceReorder calls PlaceOrder once with SKU-REJECT and quantity 8 and returns false. A subsequent ConfirmDelivery with 8 returns false, and the item's OnHand remains 2 because the rejected order was not recorded as pending.
